mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In triggered instances, 5-day returns are positive in >40% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits and consumer spending indicates broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month
failure_condition: Joint decline condition produces negative returns in <60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, supply chain disruptions intensify, reducing corporate output and profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 105 periods, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 2.5% instances, 60-day returns are positive in >40% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in consumer price inflation indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank tightens.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises in the same month
failure_condition: Joint condition produces negative returns in <60% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of weak GDP growth, consumer and business demand contraction accelerates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% periods, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
